items.source: Return the name of the currently proxied bean instance.
items.translation: 返回当前代理的 Bean 实例的名称。

items.source: the name of the bean, or null if none available
items.translation: bean 的名称，或者如果不可用则为null

items.source: Holder for the current proxy creation context, as exposed by auto-proxy creators such as AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator.
items.translation: 当前代理创建上下文的持有者，由自动代理创建器（如AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator）暴露。
